steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper.

steps.action: Each dusk, Ezra lit the lantern atop Greywhale Point, the last lonely spine of rock before the endless sea. One stormy night, the light failed—the wick drowned by wind-driven rain. In the pitch, he heard waves hammering, felt ships searching through darkness he had unwillingly cast. With trembling hands he struck a single match. Its flame, tiny yet stubborn, caught the new wick. The lens blazed again, slicing rain like a silver sword. At dawn, wreckage never came; instead, a distant captain’s horn saluted the tower. Ezra pocketed the spent match, a reminder that even the smallest light can save giants.
